frontiers.question: Is the internally frozen Paper I candidate exact, coherent and replayable inside the declared evidence boundary?
frontiers.operation_or_requirement: Pass repository verification, exact continuation replay, PDF build and unpacked reviewer-bundle SHA validation on one pinned commit.
frontiers.scope: Internal candidate quality only; it does not constitute external validation or archival completeness.
frontiers.reopening_condition: Any change to a theorem, numerical claim, terminal convention, evidence file or manuscript dependency reopens this gate.
frontiers.next_action: Preserve the pinned internal candidate while external gates proceed.

frontiers.question: Do two independent specialists endorse correctness, significance and venue fit on the same pinned commit?
frontiers.operation_or_requirement: Obtain two conflict-disclosed specialist reports pinned to the reviewed commit.
frontiers.obstacle_evidence: No independent report has yet been received; internal review cannot satisfy this requirement.
frontiers.scope: Prevents claims of external validation and final submission freeze; does not prevent internal verification, packaging or reviewer outreach.
alternatives: Invite one arithmetic-dynamics specialist and one computer-assisted-proof specialist.
Use the structured scorecard or a free-form report with commit identity and execution disclosure.
frontiers.reopening_condition: Status advances when two qualifying reports are archived and adjudicated.
frontiers.next_action: Send the final reviewer bundle to two independent specialists.

frontiers.question: Does closed-database and specialist citation chaining reveal a prior result equivalent to the frozen novelty claim?
frontiers.operation_or_requirement: Complete MathSciNet/zbMATH or equivalent citation chaining for the exact coupled claim and record specialist feedback.
frontiers.obstacle_evidence: Open-literature positioning is complete enough for internal review, but closed-database chaining and specialist priority judgment are absent.
frontiers.scope: Keeps the priority wording provisional; it does not affect the exact theorem itself.
alternatives: Specialist-assisted backward and forward citation chaining.
Author queries for the nearest adjacent systems.
frontiers.reopening_condition: Gate closes when the search protocol, query set, results and claim-by-claim adjudication are archived.
frontiers.next_action: Execute closed-database chaining without broadening the frozen novelty claim.

frontiers.question: Can an independent implementation reproduce the chronology, continuation costs and robustness intervals?
frontiers.operation_or_requirement: A genuinely independent actor must implement or replay the frozen specification and submit a signed replication report.
frontiers.obstacle_evidence: Internal exact replay passes, but it is controlled by the same research process and is not independent evidence.
frontiers.scope: Prevents the label clean-room or externally replicated; does not weaken the internal exact certificates.
alternatives: Independent implementation from the mathematical specification.
Independent execution of the published replay package with environment and provenance disclosure.
frontiers.reopening_condition: Gate closes when a qualifying external report, code identity and outputs are archived against the pinned commit.
frontiers.next_action: Recruit an external replication actor and provide the frozen packet.

frontiers.question: Is the complete depth-162 certificate durably archived or independently regenerated?
frontiers.operation_or_requirement: Deposit the complete depth-162 state certificate with cryptographic manifest, or regenerate it cleanly and archive the result.
frontiers.obstacle_evidence: The compact layer ledger and receipts are present, but the complete 329,106,757-state payload is not duplicated in ordinary Git or the current lightweight reviewer package.
frontiers.scope: Blocks archival-complete status and the strongest long-term replay posture; it does not invalidate the compact exact theorem stack or continuation certificates.
alternatives: Locate and deposit the original payload in a research-data archive.
Cleanly regenerate the exact layer with an independent engine.
Produce a checker-complete streamed certificate with explicit cryptographic commitments.
frontiers.reopening_condition: A complete payload or checker-complete regenerated certificate becomes available and passes format, count, primitive-state, deduplication and hash validation.
frontiers.next_action: Search archival storage first; if absent, design a clean regeneration and deposition plan.

frontiers.question: Which journal is selected, and does the final candidate satisfy its complete submission specification?
frontiers.operation_or_requirement: Choose the venue after specialist feedback, perform the journal-specific format audit and freeze the signed submission candidate.
frontiers.obstacle_evidence: Candidate venues, cover letters and a decision rule exist, but the venue decision is intentionally conditioned on specialist assessment.
frontiers.scope: Blocks the final formatted submission package; it does not block review outreach or theorem validation.
alternatives: Journal of Modern Dynamics if conceptual significance is endorsed.
Experimental Mathematics if the artifact-aware framing dominates.
Dynamical Systems for a concise specialist route.
Ergodic Theory and Dynamical Systems only with stronger conceptual endorsement or extension.
frontiers.reopening_condition: Specialist reports are adjudicated and one venue is selected under the frozen decision rule.
frontiers.next_action: Defer final formatting until review feedback is received; keep all candidate packages synchronized.

frontiers.question: Is the reviewed Paper I object frozen, citable and durably archived?
frontiers.operation_or_requirement: Create a signed tag, immutable release, DOI deposit and Software Heritage archival record for the final reviewed commit.
frontiers.obstacle_evidence: The internal candidate is complete, but specialist review, priority review, external replication and the full-certificate gate remain open.
frontiers.scope: Blocks claims of final DOI-backed release; it does not prevent internal candidate distribution for review.
alternatives: Pre-DOI reviewer artifact pinned to a commit.
Release candidate without final publication claims.
frontiers.reopening_condition: All required predecessor gates close and the final journal-specific candidate is frozen.
frontiers.next_action: Do not mint the final DOI before predecessor gates close.
